recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless future generated artifacts again show duplicate meta.profile values.
issue_request: FHIR-8328 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet correction raised against DSTU1. It reported that the value-set code generator duplicated the same shareable ValueSet profile URI several times in generated meta.profile output, with valueset-c80-facilitycodes as the example.
initial_application: The Jira comment says this was applied in svn revision 5557. The corresponding git-svn commit 5abf6f76ce4b9086bad1edd348c102852e94acf7 is titled '#8328 - remove duplicate profile tags' and changed ValueSetUtilities.makeShareable to return without adding the shareable profile when that profile URI already exists.
additional_context: The cited current ValueSet source is in the active DocumentReference resource area listed in source/fhir.ini. Current source/documentreference/valueset-c80-facilitycodes.xml has no meta.profile assertion, and later cleanup commits removed shareable profile metadata and then an empty meta element from that ValueSet.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current FHIR core source already satisfies the issue and no source correction is needed.
